newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon economic activity rises in June - Bank.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon economic activity rises in June - Bank.

text.p: Lebanon's economic activity grew in June to its highest level in eight months, the Bank of Lebanon said in its latest monthly bulletin.
The central bank said its coincident indicator of economic activity (January 1993 = 100) rose to 168.8 -- its highest level since October 1995 when it was 168.9.
"The coincident indicator shows a marginal increase in June relative to May, rising to 168.8 against 164.7 in May and 150.1 in April," the Bank said.
The indicator covers 12 economic sectors including imports, exports, electricity output and airport and port activity.
The Bank created the indicator because of a lack of reliable data in Lebanon since the 1975-90 war, which prevents precise calculation of Gross Domestic Product (GDP) and economic growth.
